Option Compare Database
Option Explicit
' ============================================================================
'  This form replaces the previous two-subform layout
'  (sfrmClientServiceNeeds + sfrmClientServicePlan) with two list boxes:
'
'     lstClientServiceNeeds   (master list)
'        ColumnCount   = 5
'        ColumnWidths  = "0;3120;1320;1320;3120"     ' PK hidden
'        ColumnHeads   = True
'        BoundColumn   = 1
'        Tied to: frmClientServiceNeedDetail
'
'     lstClientServicePlan    (cascades from selected need)
'        ColumnCount   = 6
'        ColumnWidths  = "0;3120;1320;1560;1560;1560" ' PK hidden
'        ColumnHeads   = True
'        BoundColumn   = 1
'        Tied to: frmClientServicePlanDetail
'
'  When the user picks a row in lstClientServiceNeeds (AfterUpdate),
'  the plan list rebuilds for that need. Until a need is picked, the
'  plan list is empty (and Add-from-plan is disabled).
' ============================================================================
Private Sub PopulateClientServiceNeeds()
    If IsNull(Me.txtClientID) Or IsNull(Me.txtFiscalYear) Then
        Me.lstClientServiceNeeds.RowSource = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim baseSql As String
    baseSql = _
        "SELECT n.ClientServiceNeedID AS ID, " & _
               "s.ServiceName AS [Service], " & _
               "n.HoursPerWeek AS [Hrs/Wk], " & _
               "n.Priority AS Priority, " & _
               "n.Notes AS Notes " & _
        "FROM tblClientServiceNeeds AS n " & _
             "INNER JOIN tblServices AS s ON s.ServiceID = n.ServiceID " & _
        "WHERE n.ClientID=" & Me.txtClientID & _
          " AND n.FiscalYear=" & Me.txtFiscalYear
    Me.lstClientServiceNeeds.RowSource = basListHelpers.BuildAddableRowSource( _
        dataSelect:=baseSql, _
        addLabel:="(Add new service need...)", _
        dataColCount:=5)
    Me.lstClientServiceNeeds.Requery
End Sub
Private Sub PopulateClientServicePlan()
    Dim selectedNeedID As Variant
    selectedNeedID = Me.lstClientServiceNeeds.Value
    ' No need selected, or "<Add new need...>" highlighted ?  empty plan list.
    If IsNull(selectedNeedID) Then
        Me.lstClientServicePlan.RowSource = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If CLng(selectedNeedID) = basListHelpers.ADD_NEW_ID Then
        Me.lstClientServicePlan.RowSource = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim baseSql As String
    baseSql = _
        "SELECT cp.ClientServicePlanID AS ID, " & _
               "p.ProviderName AS Provider, " & _
               "cp.HoursPerWeek AS [Hrs/Wk], " & _
               "Format(cp.WeeklyCost,'$#,##0.00') AS [Weekly $], " & _
               "Format(cp.AnnualEstCost,'$#,##0.00') AS [Annual $], " & _
               "cp.Status AS Status " & _
        "FROM (tblClientServicePlan AS cp " & _
              "INNER JOIN tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc " & _
                "ON psc.ProviderServiceCatalogID = cp.ProviderServiceCatalogID) " & _
              "INNER JOIN tblProviders AS p ON p.ProviderID = psc.ProviderID " & _
        "WHERE cp.ClientServiceNeedID=" & CLng(selectedNeedID)
    Me.lstClientServicePlan.RowSource = basListHelpers.BuildAddableRowSource( _
        dataSelect:=baseSql, _
        addLabel:="(Add new plan entry...)", _
        dataColCount:=6)
    Me.lstClientServicePlan.Requery
End Sub
' ============================================================================
'  Listbox events
' ============================================================================
Private Sub lstClientServiceNeeds_AfterUpdate()
    ' Selecting a different need cascades into the plan list.
    PopulateClientServicePlan
End Sub
Private Sub lstClientServiceNeeds_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
    Dim ctx As String
    ctx = basListHelpers.BuildContextArgs( _
                "ClientID", Me.txtClientID, _
                "FiscalYear", Me.txtFiscalYear)
    basListHelpers.OpenDetailFromList Me.lstClientServiceNeeds, _
                                      "frmClientServiceNeedDetail", _
                                      ctx
    ' Need set may have changed; the plan list cascades off it.
    PopulateClientServicePlan
    RefreshTotals
End Sub
Private Sub lstClientServicePlan_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
    On Error GoTo DblClickError
    Dim selectedNeedID As Variant
    selectedNeedID = Me.lstClientServiceNeeds.Value
    ' Guard: can't add/edit a plan entry if no need is selected (or the
    ' synthetic "Add new need" sentinel is highlighted).
    If IsNull(selectedNeedID) Or _
       CLng(Nz(selectedNeedID, basListHelpers.ADD_NEW_ID)) = basListHelpers.ADD_NEW_ID Then
        If Not IsNull(Me.lstClientServicePlan.Value) Then
            If CLng(Me.lstClientServicePlan.Value) = basListHelpers.ADD_NEW_ID Then
                MsgBox "Please select a service need first.", vbInformation, "No Need Selected"
            End If
        End If
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim ctx As String
    ctx = basListHelpers.BuildContextArgs( _
                "ClientServiceNeedID", CLng(selectedNeedID), _
                "FiscalYear", Me.txtFiscalYear)
    basListHelpers.OpenDetailFromList Me.lstClientServicePlan, _
                                      "frmClientServicePlanDetail", _
                                      ctx
    RefreshTotals
    Exit Sub
DblClickError:
    If Err.Number = 2501 Then
        ' Form_Load in frmClientServicePlanDetail threw an unhandled error.
        ' Check Immediate Window (Ctrl+G in VBA editor) for details.
        MsgBox "The plan detail form failed to open." & vbCrLf & _
               "Open the VBA editor and check the Immediate Window (Ctrl+G) for the error.", _
               vbExclamation, "Form Open Error (2501)"
    Else
        Err.Raise Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Current()
    ' Editable bound field
    Me.txtAnnualBudget.Locked = False
    Me.txtAnnualBudget.Enabled = True
    Me.txtAnnualBudget.BorderStyle = 1
    Me.txtAnnualBudget.TabStop = True
    ' Non-editable display/calculated fields
    Me.txtClientName.Locked = True
    Me.txtClientName.Enabled = True
    Me.txtClientName.BorderStyle = 0
    Me.txtClientName.TabStop = False
    Me.txtTotalPlanned.Locked = True
    Me.txtTotalPlanned.Enabled = True
    Me.txtTotalPlanned.BorderStyle = 0
    Me.txtTotalPlanned.TabStop = False
    Me.txtRemaining.Locked = True
    Me.txtRemaining.Enabled = True
    Me.txtRemaining.BorderStyle = 0
    Me.txtRemaining.TabStop = False
    ' Hidden FK
    Me.txtClientID.Locked = True
    ' FiscalYear is editable in Add mode, non-editable in Edit mode (it's the key)
    If Me.NewRecord Then
        Me.txtFiscalYear.Locked = False
        Me.txtFiscalYear.Enabled = True
        Me.txtFiscalYear.BorderStyle = 1
        Me.txtFiscalYear.TabStop = True
    Else
        Me.txtFiscalYear.Locked = True
        Me.txtFiscalYear.Enabled = True
        Me.txtFiscalYear.BorderStyle = 0
        Me.txtFiscalYear.TabStop = False
    End If
    ' ClientName is unbound - populate from tblClients via DLookup.
    If Not IsNull(Me.txtClientID) Then
        Me.txtClientName = Nz(DLookup("[FirstName] & ' ' & [LastName]", _
                                      "tblClients", _
                                      "ClientID=" & Me.txtClientID), "")
    Else
        Me.txtClientName = ""
    End If
    ' Button state
    Me.btnSave.Enabled = False
    Me.btnClose.Caption = "Close"
    On Error Resume Next
    Me.btnDelete.Enabled = Not Me.NewRecord
    On Error GoTo 0
    PopulateClientServiceNeeds
    Me.lstClientServicePlan.RowSource = ""
    RefreshTotals
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
    Dim args As Variant
    args = Me.OpenArgs
    If basListHelpers.IsAddMode(args) Then
        Me.DataEntry = True
    ElseIf IsNumeric(Nz(args, "")) Then
        Me.Filter = "ClientBudgetID=" & CLng(args)
        Me.FilterOn = True
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Load()
    If basListHelpers.IsAddMode(Me.OpenArgs) Then
        Dim cid As Long, fy As Long
        cid = basListHelpers.GetContextLong(Me.OpenArgs, "ClientID")
        fy = basListHelpers.GetContextLong(Me.OpenArgs, "FiscalYear")
        If cid > 0 Then Me!ClientID = cid
        If fy > 0 Then Me!FiscalYear = fy
        ' ClientName is unbound and gets populated in Form_Current via DLookup
        ' on Me.ClientID, so no explicit assignment here.
    End If
    PopulateClientServiceNeeds
    RefreshTotals
End Sub
Private Sub RefreshTotals()
    Dim totalPlanned As Currency
    Dim budget As Currency
    Dim remaining As Currency
    budget = Nz(Me.txtAnnualBudget, 0)
    totalPlanned = Nz(DSum("AnnualEstCost", "tblClientServicePlan", _
        "ClientServiceNeedID IN (SELECT ClientServiceNeedID FROM tblClientServiceNeeds " & _
        "WHERE ClientID=" & Me.txtClientID & " AND FiscalYear=" & Me.txtFiscalYear & ")"), 0)
    remaining = budget - totalPlanned
    Me.txtTotalPlanned = Format(totalPlanned, "$#,##0.00")
    Me.txtRemaining = Format(remaining, "$#,##0.00")
    If remaining < 0 Then
        Me.txtRemaining.ForeColor = RGB(192, 0, 0)
        Me.txtRemaining.FontBold = True
    ElseIf remaining < budget * 0.1 Then
        Me.txtRemaining.ForeColor = RGB(192, 96, 0)
        Me.txtRemaining.FontBold = False
    Else
        Me.txtRemaining.ForeColor = RGB(0, 96, 0)
        Me.txtRemaining.FontBold = False
    End If
End Sub
' Called by the plan detail popup form after it commits a change,
' so this form's running totals stay in sync.
Public Sub NotifyPlanChanged()
    RefreshTotals
    PopulateClientServicePlan
End Sub
Private Sub btnSave_Click()
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If Me.Dirty Then Me.Dirty = False    ' fires Form_BeforeUpdate
    Me.btnSave.Enabled = False
    Me.btnClose.Caption = "Close"
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    ' Validation canceled the save - leave the form open with current button state.
End Sub
Private Sub btnCancel_Click()
    ' Legacy button - btnClose now handles dynamic Cancel behavior.
    ' Kept here in case btnCancel still exists on the form.
    If Me.Dirty Then Me.Undo
End Sub
Private Sub btnClose_Click()
    ' When the caption is "Cancel" the form is dirty - undo first, then close.
    If Me.Dirty Then Me.Undo
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Dirty(Cancel As Integer)
    Me.btnSave.Enabled = True
    Me.btnClose.Caption = "Cancel"
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Undo(Cancel As Integer)
    Me.btnSave.Enabled = False
    Me.btnClose.Caption = "Close"
End Sub
Private Sub Form_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    If IsNull(Me!AnnualBudget) Or Me!AnnualBudget <= 0 Then
        MsgBox "Annual Budget must be greater than zero.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.txtAnnualBudget.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If IsNull(Me!FiscalYear) Then
        MsgBox "Fiscal Year is required.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.txtFiscalYear.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If IsNull(Me!ClientID) Then
        MsgBox "Client is required.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim selfID As Long
    selfID = Nz(Me!ClientBudgetID, 0)
    If DCount("*", "tblClientBudgets", _
              "ClientID=" & Me!ClientID & _
              " AND FiscalYear=" & Me!FiscalYear & _
              " AND ClientBudgetID<>" & selfID) > 0 Then
        MsgBox "A budget for this client and fiscal year already exists.", _
               vbExclamation, "Duplicate"
        Me.txtFiscalYear.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub txtFiscalYear_AfterUpdate()
    PopulateClientServiceNeeds
    Me.lstClientServicePlan.RowSource = ""
    RefreshTotals
End Sub
Private Sub btnDelete_Click()
    If Me.NewRecord Then Exit Sub
    Dim PlanCount As Long
    PlanCount = DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan", _
                       "FiscalYear=" & Me!FiscalYear & _
                       " AND ClientServiceNeedID IN " & _
                       "(SELECT ClientServiceNeedID FROM tblClientServiceNeeds " & _
                       " WHERE ClientID=" & Me!ClientID & ")")
    Dim msg As String
    msg = "Delete this budget?"
    If PlanCount > 0 Then
        msg = msg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
              "Note: " & PlanCount & " service plan entries exist for this client and FY. " & _
              "Service plans will remain but their budget reference will be gone."
    End If
    If MsgBox(msg, vbYesNo + vbQuestion + vbDefaultButton2, "Confirm Delete") = vbNo Then Exit Sub
    On Error GoTo Failed
    RunCommand acCmdSelectRecord
    RunCommand acCmdDeleteRecord
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    MsgBox "Could not delete: " & Err.Description, vbCritical, "Delete Failed"
End Sub
Private Sub Form_AfterUpdate()
    ' After saving a budget, refresh the parent frmClientDetail's lstClientBudgets
    ' so the new/edited AnnualBudget value shows there too.
    On Error Resume Next
    Forms!frmClientDetail.PopulateClientBudgets
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub
